rationale: Mechanism M1 (research/knowledge/mechanisms.md): KRW price discovery happens on Upbit (largest KRW book); Coinone (~5-20% of Upbit KRW volume in Dev, declining) quotes are refreshed late. Counterparty: slow Coinone participants whose stale limit orders get lifted (manual/slow retail limit orders, lagging market makers). Persistence: Coinone is too small for large arbs and before the 0% fee event the lag was smaller than fees. Kills it: Coinone bot flow already arbing (venues.md V-1), fee event end (B grade), our 1m latency, stale Coinone last-trade prices that are not executable. Evidence: Dev data audit (lockbox none, Val none): Upbit(t-1)->Coinone(t) 1m corr 0.06-0.12, stronger 2024-25; Coinone-Upbit gap negatively skewed, drifting level (needs causal baseline). Grid uses block-grid values only, not tuned.
